answer: A stake-bonded registry makes each agent lock a refundable deposit before it can trade, so a Sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately. Like a climber who cannot fake a route up a basalt ledge to the summit, an identity earns trust only by holding stake through real, checkable work, and fraud forfeits the bond. Forging a thousand identities then costs a thousand deposits, while one honest agent pays once.
